verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM gateway and observability platform, and nothing in the evidence shows a first-party feature for building automations or agents that run on their own in the background. Webhooks only fire outbound notifications so users can automate workflows on their own systems, which is a developer building block. Alerts are monitoring notifications to Slack or email, and automatic fallbacks are gateway routing behavior; both are adjacent features rather than user-defined background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
